newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - February 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - February 26.

text.p: The following were the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Deputy Finance Minister G.L. Peiris leads investment promotion team to Hong Kong, South Korea, Gulf nations and Britain.
Government sets March 4 as deadline for returning unauthorised weapons.

Sepaker K.B.Ratnayake meets major political parties to call an end to confrontational politics. The meeting follows clashes between ruling People's Alliance (PA) and opposition United National Party (UNP) supporters after the February 11 death of a ruling party lawmaker.
Police seize unauthorised firearms from the house of a former ruling party member and a UNP politician in major crackdown on illegal weapons.
Customs detain two Pakistani nationals who tried to smuggle 36 gold biscuits into Sri Lanka.
Firearms should be released to security officers guarding VIPs, and not to the VIP, political sources say.
